text:
Maya K: Need a short battlecard + SDR script focused on inference economics vs cloud-managed endpoints and infra vendors. Can someone take a stab?
Jamal: Ill draft a one-pager today. Keep it 3 bullets, 2 guarded bench claims, 3 quick rebuttals, and routing rules.
Linh: Bench language: use a concrete workload e.g. 'conversational agent, 2k context, 8 concurrent streams' and qualifiers like 'in our tests' and 'up to'.
Alice: Legal: avoid concrete invoice numbers. 'Up to 3x token cost reduction in our tests' is ok with a link to the appendix.
Sara: Routing rules: mention 'compliance' -> AE-Priv, 'cost predictability' -> SDR-Pricing, 'latency SLO' -> AE-Performance. Also add a quick email subject line.
Jamal: Drafted 3 bullets: 1) Predictable unit economics via Dedicated reservations; 2) Lower tail latency with routing + KV cache; 3) Private/VPC option for regulated apps. Bench: conversational workload (2k/8 streams)  in our tests, up to 3x token cost reduction vs naive single-request endpoints. Rebuttals: autoscale = bursts not steady savings; managed endpoints can be migrated gradually; private deploys integrate with KMS/audit logs.
Maya K: Nice. Keep SDR openers super short. Example DM: 'Hey <first>, quick Q: do inference invoices surprise you when traffic stabilizes?'
Linh: Add link to benchmark appendix: https://redwood.internal/benchmarks/inference-econ (marketing-view).
Alice: Looping legal now, will post sign-off or edits by EOD.
Sara: I'll make the routing checklist and an email subject. Want to ship this as enablement by next Wednesday.
Maya K: Plan set. Jamal finalize after legal. Thanks :rocket:
